description: This Java class implements the OrderSetDAO interface using Hibernate for database persistence. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting OrderSet, OrderSetAttributeType, and related entities, managing interaction with the Hibernate session factory.

classes.name: HibernateOrderSetDAO
classes.description: Implementation of OrderSetDAO using Hibernate ORM, managing database operations for OrderSet entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an OrderSet entity in the database.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderSet entities, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSetById
methods.description: Fetches an OrderSet by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUniqueUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet matching a specific UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetMember entity by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates an OrderSetAttributeType entity.
